about: World countries from Brandon's filled sheet KPC_World_Keys_filled.xlsx (Nov 1 2026, rows marked 'ready' with an ArcGIS layer). kpc_world_key.py reads it: each layer = an official source, namef = the park-name field, kinds = local kind words (dropped from names when matching). WFS / download rows are listed in 'later'.
